title: Give operators one command that syncs a project's task data with its shared remote (wire the delta exchange into the CLI)
outcome: Give operators one command that syncs a project's task data with its shared remote (wire the delta exchange into the CLI)
acceptance: On a configured project, the documented `engram task-sync sync` command incrementally exports task data, fetches the configured Git data branch, reconciles incoming changes by importing when histories diverge, commits the resulting data and publishes with a fast-forward push. The operator supplies no Git commands, inventory roots, fingerprints or baseline IDs.

The command runs on Windows, macOS and Linux and is exercised by behavior tests that drive it end to end through the CLI against a local test remote, including a rejected push resolved by re-fetch and reconciliation
The supported remote transports are stated in docs/shipped.md and the git-task-sync brief, including whether SSH or local-path remotes are supported in addition to HTTPS
